channel.title: Real Korea Trip
channel.description: Step-by-step guides for T-money, trains, apps, food and the cities beyond Seoul — written for first-time visitors to South Korea.

item.title: 10 Apps for Traveling in Korea: What Each One Does

item.title: Korean Etiquette for Travelers: Restaurants, Table Manners and the Subway
